feed.headline: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
feed.ai: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

feed.headline: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
feed.ai: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

feed.headline: Hungary expels 10 Russian diplomats as relations worsen
feed.ai: For years, Hungary was viewed as Russia's closest ally in the EU, but the new government has dropped the pro-Kremlin stance.

feed.headline: How significant are AfD's historic gains for Germany and the rest of Europe?
feed.ai: The BBC's Europe editor Katya Adler sees the far-right win in Saxony-Anhalt state ringing alarm bells for the EU and traditional parties.

feed.headline: Thousands Gather for Funeral of Norway’s King Harald
feed.ai: Royal families and heads of state, including President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine, attended the funeral of King Harald V in Oslo.

feed.headline: This Tiny Anti-Establishment Party May Put Germany’s Far Right in Power
feed.ai: Germany’s far right won a state election but fell short of a majority. Its path to power depends on a small populist group that defies traditional labels.

feed.headline: Ukraine’s Unexpected $27 Billion Budget Gap Rattles Europe
feed.ai: An unexpected request from President Volodymyr Zelensky offered a stark reminder that the cost of the war will rise, challenging Europe.

feed.headline: Israeli Allies Ban Trade With Settlements as U.K. Cites ‘Ethnic Cleansing’
feed.ai: Britain, Canada and France on Tuesday announced sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank, with Britain saying Israel had “turned a blind eye” to violence against Palestinians.

feed.headline: AfD’s Far Right Win Puts New Pressure on Germany’s Leader Merz
feed.ai: Antipathy to Chancellor Friedrich Merz was a reason the far right surged in a state election. Though he does not face a national election until 2029, his leadership is under increasing scrutiny.

feed.headline: Jean-François Leroy, Champion of Photography at Its Rawest, Dies at 69
feed.ai: His photojournalism festival, Visa Pour l’Image, brought to wide attention images of war and suffering. The French president called him “a great defender of reality.”

feed.headline: Thailand investigates after British influencer dies following penis enlargement operation
feed.ai: The case has reignited debate about medical tourism, with Thailand a leading destination for visitors from abroad seeking healthcare, including cosmetic procedures.

feed.headline: 'Turning blind eye' to AfD win further angers voters, political scientist warns
feed.ai: Chancellor Merz's government must recognise the far-right AfD's victory in Saxony-Anhalt and voter discontent that led to the win, or further cement its downfall, an expert on East German politics warned.
